Scale and translate an image

Source: R/image.R
image_scale_and_translate.Rd

Port of jax.image.scale_and_translate: resamples image to shape so that a location x of the input maps to x * scale + translation along each dimension in spatial_dims (pixels are centered at half integers). Output locations whose source lies outside the input are zero.

Usage

image_scale_and_translate(
  image,
  shape,
  spatial_dims,
  scale,
  translation,
  method,
  antialias = TRUE,
  precision = "highest"
)

Arguments

image

An array.

shape

Integer vector, the output shape.

spatial_dims

0-based dimensions to transform.

scale, translation

Arrays (or numbers) with one entry per spatial dimension.

method

A method name (see image_ResizeMethod); "nearest" is not supported.

antialias

Antialias when downsampling.

precision

Precision of the contractions.

Value

The resampled array.
